versions.document:
---
type: requirement
id: envoy-delivers-messages
kind: behavior
text:
  - Envoy delivers each message that a sender writes.

---
type: check
id: a-sent-message-reaches-a-listener
serves: envoy-delivers-messages
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestASentMessageReachesAListener
  job: go-checks
claim: A message that a sender writes reaches a listener that is connected.
procedure_text:
  - The program connects one listener and writes one message.
  - It must find the message at the listener.
failing_example:
  - A sender that drops each message.

---
type: requirement
id: a-message-reaches-a-late-session
kind: behavior
parent: envoy-delivers-messages
text:
  - A session that connects after a message was written gets that message.

---
type: check
id: a-late-session-gets-the-message
serves: a-message-reaches-a-late-session
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestALateSessionGetsTheMessage
  job: go-checks
claim: A session that connects after a write gets the message of that write.
procedure_text:
  - The program writes one message and then connects one session.
  - It must find the message in the session.
failing_example:
  - A listener that delivers only the messages that arrive after a session connects.

---
type: requirement
id: a-message-survives-a-restart
kind: behavior
parent: envoy-delivers-messages
text:
  - A message that Envoy stored before a restart reaches its session after the restart.

---
type: check
id: a-restart-keeps-the-message
serves: a-message-survives-a-restart
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestARestartKeepsTheMessage
  job: go-checks
claim: A stored message reaches its session after the listener starts again.
procedure_text:
  - The program stores one message, starts the listener again and reads the session.
  - It must find the message one time.
failing_example:
  - A listener that deletes its stored messages when it starts.
